svg.title: Three readings of an open-tube manometer
svg.desc: Each U tube has gas pressure on the left and atmospheric pressure on the right. Equal pressures give equal liquid levels. Positive gauge pressure lowers the left surface; negative gauge pressure raises it. The same horizontal level in connected stationary liquid has the same pressure. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Gauge pressure can be positive, zero, or negative
Read the difference between the levels.
Quasi-static imposed pressure changes. Connected liquid volume is conserved; h is height upward.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
